text: 你担心有人可能身处险境，也可能这场骚乱与房间被盗有关，于是赶紧前去查看。
你发现隔壁房间的门开着，里面有个高大、看着眼熟的男人，穿着深色西装。他正俯视着倒在地上、遍体鳞伤的佛教僧侣。显然那个穿西装的男人刚刚痛打了他一顿。
穿西装的男人背对着你，你猜他还没发现你。运气好的话，你可以趁他不备，迅速制服他。
另外，如果你在埃斯伯里期间拿到过枪，也可以诉诸致命武力。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 142
text: Fearing that someone might be in danger, or perhaps that this commotion is somehow related to the theft from your room, you rush to investigate.

You find the adjacent room’s door open, and inside you discover a large and familiar-looking man in a dark suit. He looms over the prone body of a beaten and bloodied Buddhist monk. The man in the suit has clearly worked him over.
The suited man has his back to you, and you doubt you’ve been noticed yet. With a little luck, you might be able to get the drop on him and subdue him quickly.
Alternatively, if you have come into possession of a firearm during your stay in Esbury, you could always resort to lethal force.
